title: Punctuation and Pauses
synopsis: Have you thought about how to separate Chinese characters into words? Here are some sentences where that is very important for understanding.

fullText.simplified:
断句很重要

    “这几天天天天气不好”、“骑车出门差点摔跤，还好我一把把把把住了”……
    什么“天天天天”、“把把把把”？看着是不是有点头晕？中文博大精深，一个字可以有好几个读音，可以和别的字组成不同的意思，连起来还可以成为一句通顺的句子。这时候，断句就显得非常重要了。
    在哪断句可以读懂这些句子的意思呢？我们一起来看一下吧！
    “这几天天天天气不好”，那么多个“天”字，其实是这几个词语组合而来：“这几天”、“天天”、“天气”。“这几天/天天/天气/不好”，现在你读懂这句话的意思了吧？
    同样的，“还好我一把把把把住了”，是由“一把”、“把”、“把”、“把住”这几个词组合而来。所以，这句话就是“骑车出门差点摔跤，还好/我/一把/把/把/把住/了”。
    这样的句子还有很多。比如，校长对学生说：“衣服上除了校徽别别别的。”但学生还是别了别的东西。于是，校长说：“让你别别别的你非得别别的。”再比如，电视剧中的小龙女来到杨过曾经生活过的地方，她动情地说：“我也想过过过儿过过的生活。”……
    怎么样？这些句子你能看懂吗？如果能，你的中文肯定很棒！
fullText.traditional:
斷句很重要

    “這幾天天天天氣不好”、“騎車出門差點摔跤，還好我一把把把把住了”……
    什麼“天天天天”、“把把把把”？看著是不是有點頭暈？中文博大精深，一個字可以有好幾個讀音，可以和別的字組成不同的意思，連起來還可以成為一句通順的句子。這時候，斷句就顯得非常重要了。
    在哪斷句可以讀懂這些句子的意思呢？我們一起來看一下吧！
    “這幾天天天天氣不好”，那麼多個“天”字，其實是這幾個詞語組合而來：“這幾天”、“天天”、“天氣”。“這幾天/天天/天氣/不好”，現在你讀懂這句話的意思了吧？
    同樣的，“還好我一把把把把住了”，是由“一把”、“把”、“把”、“把住”這幾個詞組合而來。所以，這句話就是“騎車出門差點摔跤，還好/我/一把/把/把/把住/了”。
    這樣的句子還有很多。比如，校長對學生說：“衣服上除了校徽別別別的。”但學生還是別了別的東西。於是，校長說：“讓你別別別的你非得別別的。”再比如，電視劇中的小龍女來到楊過曾經生活過的地方，她動情地說：“我也想過過過兒過過的生活。”……
    怎麼樣？這些句子你能看懂嗎？如果能，你的中文肯定很棒！

raw.synopsis: Have you thought about how to separate Chinese characters into words? Here are some sentences where that is very important for understanding.
sentence_translations: Punctuation and Pauses Are Very Important
“The weather has been bad every day these past few days”,
“I almost fell over when I went biking, fortunately I grabbed a firm hold of the handlebars”...
What are these “tiantiantiantian” and “babababa”? Doesn’t it make you a bit dizzy looking at it?
Chinese is wide-ranging and profound. One character can have quite a few pronunciations,
It can form different meanings together with other characters,
And can also connect together and form a clear and coherent sentence.
At this time, punctuation appears to be extremely important.
How do you punctuate these sentences to be able to read and understand the meaning then? We’ll look together a bit!
“The weather has been bad every day these past few days”,
That many “tian” characters are actually formed from these words and expressions:
“These few days”, “every day”, “weather”.
“These few days/every day/weather/bad”, do you understand the meaning of this sentence now?
In the same way, “fortunately I grabbed a firm hold of the handlebars” ..
Is built together from the words “a handful”, “object marking particle”, “handlebar”, “to grab firmly”.
As a result, this sentence is then...
“I almost fell over when I went biking, fortunately/I/a handful/object marking particle/the handlebar/grab firmly/completed action marker”.
There are many more of this kind of sentences in addition to these.
For example, a principal said to a student: “Don’t pin other things than the school badge to your clothes”.
But the student still pinned other things.
So, the principal said: “Even though I told you not to pin other things, you still had to pin other things didn’t you?”
Yet another example, Little Dragon Girl in a TV-drama came to the place where Yang Guo once lived.
She said in a moved way: “I also want to live the life that Guo’er lived before” …
What do you think? Can you understand these sentences? If you can, your Chinese is definitely excellent!
